blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robin Padilla has shared a copy of his negative drug test result online, urging elected officials not to be afraid of undergoing testing as well. According to the senator, it is part of promoting clean, responsible, and honest public service. “In support of the directive issued by DILG (Department of the Interior and Local Government) Secretary Jonvic Remulla and initiated by Reina Mercedes, Isabela Vice Mayor Jeryll Harold Respicio, elected and appointed public officials should not debate whether to undergo drug testing,” Padilla was quoted as saying in Filipino in a post on his Facebook page last […]...
